channel.title: Rheumatology
channel.description: Medical bulletin portal with the latest verified evidence across 19 specialties: vascular surgery, general surgery, OB/GYN, pediatrics, cardiology, internal medicine, neurology, oncology, orthopedics, urology, gastroenterology, nephrology, pulmonology, endocrinology, emergency medicine, infectious diseases, dermatology, psychiatry and rheumatology. Full text and a short audio newscast for every issue.

item.title: Monthly rheumatology bulletin — October 18, 2026
item.description: Colleagues: this issue covers September 18 to October 18, 2026. It was a transition month ahead of ACR Convergence (November 6–11): few large trials published, several regulatory decisions, and industry-reported results…
